detail: TC-BUG-32-01 and TC-BUG-32-04 are planned at the functional layer with OrderingApiFixture as the precondition. They are implemented only as Playwright request tests on the test stack, and the functional test class just says so in a comment. The assertions are complete, and the stack exercises the real OpenAPI pipeline and real auth. Still, the layer differs from the plan, and the test-stack run is the only coverage of the main defect assertion.
